title: 2026 $1 Uncirculated Coin – Holey Dollar $35 + $9.95 Delivery ($0 over $60 Spend) @ Australia Post
body:
Deal: 2026 $1 Uncirculated Coin – Holey Dollar $35 + $9.95 Delivery ($0 over $60 Spend) @ Australia Post

[Herbs] Why is it important? It's just a piece of metal.
[kaybrr] Everything in the universe is “just” something: a person is just atoms, a painting is just pigment, a coin is just metal. Importance comes from what something carries: history, memory, rarity, and the fact that humans decided it meant something.
[fantombloo] Unlike the others, a person is sentient therefore automatically important to themself. They are someone, not just something.
[BatmanAU] Wow only 35000 made, best get one in case 34998 lose theirs and it becomes worth $2
[randomsquat] Retail price, undiscounted.
Not a bargain…belongs on NOtzBargain.com.au
[coldazure] i'm ashamed that i tried to access that website…
[kaybrr] It's a cool talking point for coin day at school.
[Lucille Bluth] $9.95 shipping is criminal, especially even more so since the seller is AusPost.
[kaybrr] $9.95 is for shipping but postage is free if you buy 2 dollars or more, maximum 20 dollars
[mattman] Commercial rates i get via work are much better than $9.95 for a small parcel. So yes, this is crap.
[MakeBread] Out of interest, is this actually money? Guessing if i used it to buy bread the clerk wouldn't want it.
[Domingo] Those are rookie numbers - if you're looking to overpay for a $1 coin, may as well do it properly:
$1 coin for $155
$1 coin for $190
I mean you could pay for someone else's groceries and your own, or instead get one of each!
